notes.title: Release May 2019
notes.notes:
Hell Hole will be available in May 2019.  All work has been done by myself, an indie developer trying to make my way in the world!

I do hope you like what you see so far and post any suggestions, improvements you would like to see in the full game.

Please find a web playable demo here:

https://steg90.itch.io/hell-hole

Many thanks!
